I understand the importance of school, but frankly a lot of the things kids learn in school have nothing to do with living as an adult. 

Overworked, underpaid parents are expected to teach kids the ins and outs of how to balance finances, how to build resumes, help with mountains of homework, transport them to extracurricular activities, cosign for student loans, etc. while public schools are requiring advanced math and science credits that are useless unless the kids are actually passionate about going into fields that require that knowledge.
